content: Hey! Let me know if you need any help with the inheritance fund paperwork or the bank transfer steps. I have all the reference details ready from last week's update.
I wanted to double-check if Aunt Linda's transfer to my account is already showing up. She said she used the SWIFT code CITIUS33 and included my full name in the memo.

Great, let me look that up. Yes, Linda M. Harper's transfer of $7,300 on May 28th is pending final clearance with CitiBank's SWIFT code CITIUS33. Since she listed you as Daniel J. Harper and used your account ending 0742, it matches perfectly.
Awesome, thanks! Could you remind me of the transaction reference number? The bank might ask for it if there's a delay.

Of course. The wire transfer reference is 20240528-HARP-7312. If they need confirmation, you can also mention Linda's registered email, l.harper.family@gmail.com, and your phone number ending 0891 for faster lookup.
Perfect, I'll save that. Will the funds be available before Friday? I have to submit a notarized statement to the estate office by noon.

Given the usual processing time, the funds should clear by Thursday 5 PM at the latest. If you don't see the $7,300 in your checking account (ending 0742) by then, contact CitiBank support directly with the SWIFT code and reference 20240528-HARP-7312 for urgent review.
Thanks for the heads-up. Aunt Linda's been really anxious about timing, so this helps.

No problem! Since everything's aligned with your personal details and the transfer memo, it should be smooth. Just keep an eye on your email (daniel.harper89@gmail.com) for the bank's confirmation notice as well.
